title: Lazycat's Partially Transparent Armor
description: Armor is partially transparent. only the outlines armor are shown. letting you see the skin easily while not disabling armor view fully.
body:
**Armor is partially transparent. only the outlines of the armor are shown. letting you see the skin easily while not disabling armor view fully.**

like this :D

![5 armor stands stand adjacent to each other. wearing chainmail, iron, netherite, diamond and leather in order from left to right. showing how the resource pack changes the armor as only the outlines of the armor are visible. showing the armor stand inside so u can see the skin when woren on the player.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/10dde7a051e9403b13e527cd367f9488135abe70.png)

as of now it supports

- Leather Armor
- Chainmail Armor
- Iron Armor
- Diamond Armor
- Netherite Armor
- Turtle shell helmets

-------
## How to install
(if you do not understand check out youtube tutorials or the wiki)


### on Windows :
download the resource pack and u should see a file named 
```
Lazy's PaTrAr
```
 or 
```
Lazy's PaTrAr.zip
```
downloaded. 
now copy the file and then press win+R to open the run dialouge
it will show up in the bottom left of your screen
now erase whatever is typed in the box and type 
```
%appdata%
```

now press ENTER

it should open a folder with lots of files. find "minecraft" and open it 
then u should see a "resource pack" folder
paste the file there

now open the game go to options. click on resource packs and enable it.
### on Linux:
download the resource pack and u should see a file named "Lazy's PaTrAr" or "Lazy's PaTrAr.zip" downloaded. 
now copy the file and then
go to ur home directory and enable "show hidden files" if u dont know how to look it up based on ur file manager.
now u should see a file named ".minecraft" open it and go into the "resource packs" folder and paste the zip file u copied there.

now open the game go to options. click on resource packs and enable it.
### on mac:
download the resource pack and you should see a file named "Lazy's PaTrAr" or "Lazy's PaTrAr.zip" downloaded.
now copy the file.
open Finder and in the top menu bar click Go → Go to Folder…
a small box will appear. erase whatever is in it and type:
```
~/Library/Application Support/minecraft
```
then press Enter
it should open a folder with lots of files. find "resourcepacks" (or "resource packs" depending on version) and open it.
paste the file there.
now open the game go to options. click on resource packs and enable it.
